The 1960 deed gave the friend a fee simple subject to a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25. That executory interest is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities, because church use and attainment of age 25 might occur more than 21 years after the deaths of everyone alive at the conveyance. Striking it leaves the friend with the vacant lot in fee simple absolute.
CONFIDENCE: 84
